response.sql: WITH type_avgs AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_avg FROM type_avgs t, overall o WHERE t.type_avg > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS mean_avg FROM kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.production_type_code, k.type_avg FROM kept k, kept_mean m WHERE k.type_avg > m.mean_avg) SELECT (SELECT AVG(type_avg) FROM remaining) AS avg_type_price, (SELECT AVG(type_avg) FROM remaining) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall) AS diff_from_overall, (SELECT AVG(type_avg) FROM remaining) - (SELECT mean_avg FROM kept_mean) AS diff_from_kept_mean;
